description: Player stuck bug. Find the root cause of the player becoming trapped (candidates: fences, gates, pens, paddock lean-to colliders, water/deep-water, terrain step height, spawn inside a solid, homestead structures placed over the player, build-mode blocks) and fix it. Add an always-available escape (unstuck/respawn key + touch button, returns to a safe deterministic spot, does not alter sim hashes or journal in a way that breaks old saves unless already journaled-safe).
steps: Read Game/src/sim/character.ts, app/explore.ts, sim/world.ts, sim/construction.ts to understand the player collision model and step/slope limits

Read sim/homestead.ts + render/homestead.ts for which fences/gates/pens/lean-to/crops/buildings are solid for the player and where they are placed relative to terrain; look for enclosed pockets, 1-voxel-wide gaps, step heights above max step, water that blocks, and gates that never open for the player

Write a failing reproduction test (new Game/tests/m007.stuck.test.ts): programmatically walk/probe the player collision across the homestead layout (e.g. flood-fill reachability from spawn over a grid using the real collision/step function for several seeds, and assert no walkable cell within the homestead is enclosed/unreachable from outside, and that a player at any reachable cell can reach the spawn). Also assert the unstuck function returns a free (non-intersecting) position
Fix the root cause in the sim/collision or layout code

Add unstuck: keyboard (e.g. R held/pressed with brief hold) and a touch-controls button (app/touch-controls.ts), plus automatic detection (e.g. no displacement for N seconds while input held) offering a hint; implement as player-only state, not part of saved sim hash
Document cause and fix in 13_Integration_and_QA/Evidence/M007b/REPORT.md (create), with sections: Deployed vs merged; Tests vs live-browser; Visual model vs simulation behaviour
acceptance_criteria: New regression test fails on pre-fix code and passes after
Reachability test over several seeds shows no trapped pockets
All existing tests still pass, old-save hashes unchanged
verification: cd Game && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npm run build
findings: Root cause: single jump peak 0.99 m and step-up 1.05 m, so any hole or ledge 2+ voxels deep traps the player permanently. Reachability probe on seed 1337 with founder house, path and terraces built: 11570 standing positions, 0 trapped (one-off, ~74 s, not kept in the suite). Homestead fences and pens have no player colliders. Per user steering: no unstuck or respawn key. Added a double jump instead: a second Jump tap in the air launches at DOUBLE_JUMP_SPEED=8.4 m/s, once per jump, reset on ground or water (character.ts, new airJumpUsed field, not saved or hashed). Keyboard and touch already queue a jump per press via setJumpHeld; updated hints in main.ts and index.html aria-label. Test added to tests/m004.character.test.ts (fails pre-fix). Tests: 191 pass. Tracked Game/dist and tests/.build were regenerated and committed. REPORT.md created in 13_Integration_and_QA/Evidence/M007b/.
